Annual Audit Plan Target

Set the total number of planned audit cycles for the entire annual audit plan. This can be 2, 20, 30, or any valid annual target.

This annual plan target is saved to Firebase by year. The dashboard distributes the target across Q1–Q4 for quarter filtering; existing detailed cycle records remain unchanged.
